Here is a draft for your LinkedIn post that strikes a good balance between celebrating your achievement and offering your expertise.

***

**Headline: A new chapter with the CDS Hooks project! 🚀**

I’m thrilled to share that I have officially joined the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee! 

This technology has been a major part of my professional life since 2017. Over the last seven years, I’ve watched this standard grow from a promising concept into a vital component of the clinical decision support ecosystem. It has been a privilege to watch how developers and health systems utilize these hooks to deliver real-time, actionable insights to clinicians at the point of care.

Now, as a member of the PMC, I’m excited to play a more active role in shaping the roadmap, addressing challenges, and helping move the CDS Hooks standard forward. I’m looking forward to collaborating with the rest of the committee to ensure the standard continues to meet the evolving needs of the health IT community.

**Two quick asks for the community:**

1. **Are you already using CDS Hooks?**
We want to highlight your work! Please take a moment to add your implementation to our Community Availability wiki: https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability. It’s a great way to showcase how your organization is leveraging the standard to improve clinical workflows.

2. **Are you looking to get started?**
If your team is trying to implement CDS Hooks but needs a helping hand to get off the ground, I am now available as a freelance consultant. I’d love to help you navigate the implementation, integration, and best practices. Send me a DM if you'd like to chat!

Excited for what’s ahead for the standard and for the community. Let’s keep building!

#CDSHooks #HealthIT #Interoperability #FHIR #ClinicalDecisionSupport #HealthTech #DigitalHealth
